title: Phase 7 L1b miner proposal bundle
description: Schema for analysis/telemetry/miner_proposals.json produced by scripts/phase_7_miner.py (v1.2.18, L1b skeleton). One file per miner run; aggregates telemetry snapshots over a window and emits zero or more tuning proposals against config/tunables.yaml entries. v1.2.18 SHIPS THE SKELETON ONLY — the mining algorithm itself is a stub that always returns empty `proposals` (real pattern-detection / statistical-significance gates land in a future release once enough pilot telemetry exists). NOT canonical state. NOT F5-validated. NOT in POLICY_GLOBS. Strictly read-only with respect to canonical state — proposals are advisory, never auto-applied (L2 / v1.2.19 ships the patcher that turns proposals into PR-ready patches; analyst sign-off is still required to merge). See docs/phase_7_design.md for the full L0 → L1a → L1b → L2 architecture.

schema_version.description: Miner-proposal-bundle shape version. v1.2.18 ships 1.0; bumped on breaking shape changes (additive optional fields keep 1.0).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the miner produced this bundle. Same shape as telemetry_run.captured_at (without ±HH:MM offset — UTC-only).

window_days.description: Rolling window length in days. Telemetry runs whose `captured_at` is older than (today_utc - window_days) are excluded from analysis. v1.2.18 default 30; CLI override via --window-days.

today_utc.description: UTC reference date for the window calculation. Production runs use today's UTC date; tests inject a fixed value via --today.

runs_total.description: All `run_*.json` files discovered in the telemetry directory, regardless of window or validity.

runs_in_window.description: Runs whose `captured_at` falls within (today_utc - window_days, today_utc] AND pass the lightweight top-level shape check (required fields present + correct types — full jsonschema validation against telemetry_run.schema.json is the caller's responsibility, kept out of the stdlib-only miner).

runs_excluded_outside_window.description: Runs that passed the shape check AND parsed `captured_at` as a strict YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ timestamp BUT fell outside the window — either older than `today_utc - window_days` or future-dated relative to `today_utc`. Note: a `captured_at` that doesn't parse as the strict Z-suffixed UTC form is classified as **malformed**, not outside-window (it's broken input, not a valid out-of-range value).

runs_excluded_malformed.description: Files counted as broken input. Includes: (a) JSON-parse failures; (b) files whose top-level shape doesn't include the telemetry-run required fields (`schema_version` / `captured_at` / `run_id` / `plugin_version` / `canon_policy_version` / `kpi_observations` / `summary`); (c) files whose `captured_at` field is a string but doesn't parse as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` (e.g., `+02:00` offsets, fractional seconds, missing-Z forms — the miner narrows captured_at parsing for window-arithmetic safety, see scripts/phase_7_miner.py docstring). Operator-readable signal: 'X telemetry files are corrupt or non-UTC'.

proposals_count.description: Total proposals in the `proposals` array. v1.2.18 stub algorithm always returns 0 — real algorithm in a future release.

proposals_immutable_conflict_count.description: Subset of proposals where `immutable_conflict=true`. The L2 patcher (v1.2.19) MUST refuse to emit a patch for these, regardless of analyst sign-off — they would violate INV-XX. Always 0 in v1.2.18 stub but pinned in the schema so L2 can rely on the field.

proposals.description: Zero or more tuning proposals against config/tunables.yaml entries. v1.2.18 stub algorithm returns []. Each proposal is advisory until L2 (v1.2.19) materializes it as a patch + analyst sign-off + manual PR.

proposal_id.description: Stable identifier `P7-<short-context>-NNNN` (e.g., `P7-KPI001-0001`). Lets L2 dedupe proposals across miner runs. Context segment is uppercase ASCII letters + digits only — the character class deliberately excludes `/`, `.`, `\`, and other path-component characters so the patcher can use the id as a filename without path-traversal risk.

tunable_id.description: Must match an `id` from `config/tunables.yaml`. The L2 patcher resolves this to (source_file, source_line, allowed_range).

current_value.description: Verbatim copy of `tunables.yaml[tunable_id].current_value` at miner run time. Lets L2 detect drift between miner observation and present state.

proposed_value.description: Suggested replacement value. Must be parseable as the same type as `current_value` (numeric tunables only in v1.2.18; enum tunables out of scope until phase_7_lint extends to non-numeric ranges). MUST fall within `tunables.yaml[tunable_id].allowed_range` — the L2 patcher rejects out-of-range proposals.

confidence.description: Mining confidence in [0, 1]. Reserved for future statistical significance gating; v1.2.18 stub never emits proposals so the field is shape-only here.

evidence_run_ids.description: Telemetry `run_id` values that produced the signal motivating this proposal. Provenance per Safety Contract item 3 (every L1 patch carries the telemetry rows it observed).

linked_invariants.description: Mirror of `tunables.yaml[tunable_id].linked_invariants`. Empty list when the tunable touches no invariant.

change_class.description: Mirror of `tunables.yaml[tunable_id].change_class`. Lets L2 dispatch differently — L1_auto_tunable proposals can become PR-ready patches automatically; L2_proposal_only proposals require analyst sign-off before any patch is generated.

immutable_conflict.description: True iff `change_class == L1_auto_tunable` AND `linked_invariants` is non-empty. The L2 patcher MUST refuse to emit a patch for any proposal with this flag set, regardless of analyst sign-off — applying it would violate the IMMUTABLE_CONFLICT lint rule (phase_7_lint.py C5). The miner sets this flag defensively so a misconfigured tunable can't slip through L2.

rationale.description: Human-readable explanation: why this tunable, what telemetry pattern motivated the proposal, what risk the change addresses. Required so analysts have context during L2 sign-off.
